source_lessons: Megatron backward is a custom autograd.Function with no collective at this commit.
The saved softmax is FP32 and is mutated in place as the gradient buffer.
Non-owning ranks use a safe zero local target index and a zero subtraction weight.
The exact backward boundary creates arange_1d and softmax_update inside the source helper.
runtime_lessons: Real ctx.saved_tensors match an independent full-vocabulary FP32 oracle.
TP=2 rank-local direct gradients pass on both ranks; maximum direct-vs-oracle error was 2.98e-8.
Backward-only NVTX capture contains seven local CUDA kernel families and no NCCL kernel.
Latency asymmetry follows physical GPU mapping; GPU1 had an unrelated CUDA process and GPU0 showed higher temperature/clock variability.
performance_lessons: The old 0.87 ms/5.32 ms measurements were rank-wait contaminated and are not the baseline.
The isolated baseline uses current-stream CUDA events and excludes barriers from the timed interval.
A future candidate must use the same saved-state, output aliasing, temporary allocation, stream, and timing policy.
optimization_status: No backward Agent candidate, score, or incumbent was created in Phase 15-C.1.
